$comment: Canonical store metadata (Sprint A5). docs/mobile/store-submission.md maps every field to the App Store Connect and Play Console forms. mobile:audit --store enforces required fields + populated screenshots before a release build ships.

coppa.$comment: Derived from docs/compliance/state-privacy-matrix.md + docs/legal/privacy-program.md — do not edit without compliance review.
coppa.play_familiesPolicyNote: Mixed-audience app: children use the learner surface only after verifiable parental consent collected in-app; adult roles (parent/teacher/therapist/caregiver) are the account holders. Not enrolled in Designed for Families; child data practices follow COPPA via the in-app VPC flow.
coppa.appStore_kidsCategoryNote: Not in the Kids Category: accounts are created by adults and the app serves mixed audiences. Child sessions run under parent-granted consent (COPPA VPC), no third-party advertising, no tracking (NSPrivacyTracking=false).

dataSafety.$comment: Play Data-Safety form rows; mirrors ios.privacyManifests in app.json. linked = associated with identity; all purposes are App functionality; nothing is shared with third parties for advertising; no data is 'sold'.

collected.purpose: App functionality (speech answers; only while using the microphone feature)

dataSafety.deletionPath: In-app: Parent > Privacy > Delete data; also https://aivolearning.com/privacy-policy (DSAR)

easOwner.verify: Run `eas whoami` + `eas project:info` on the release host before every production build (cannot be verified from CI containers; recorded in docs/mobile/store-submission.md).
